done: stop sharing whatever this machine lends (as potluck host stop does)
remove the home ~/.potluck: this machine's identity, the pools it runs and their data, and the daemon's log
remove the programs in ~/.local/bin: potluck, potluck-driver-tart (this one last)
not_removed: the tart.app Potluck installed (~/Applications/tart.app, Tart 2.42.0; its record is ~/Library/Application Support/potluck/tart-install.json); the Tart images Potluck pulled (ghcr.io/sengirunners/potluck-macos@sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa, about 27 GB). `tart delete <name>` removes an image, and tart.app can go to the Trash

Potluck's menu bar app, if you installed it (Potluck.app, or before its rename Potluck Menu.app, in your Applications folder unless you put it elsewhere; not another program's app of that name): quit it from its menu, remove it from System Settings > General > Login Items, and delete the app (docs/menubar.md)
a Tailscale node named potluck-<this Mac's host name>-potluck, if you used Tailscale: remove it in the Tailscale admin console (https://login.tailscale.com/admin/machines)
warning: This deletes this machine's identity for good. This machine runs these pools, and they end for all their members: friends.
